validator_p1_correction.defect_summary: Gate 6 (EVERY_OPEN_NEXT_ROW_HAS_DETAIL) and Gate 8 (HOST_REQUIRED_QUALIFICATION_VALID) used headers.indexOf('Work') for BOTH state and work in the Current frontier branch, aliasing the two cells. On the current 207-line board (which has no State column in Current frontier) the bug was latent because the check fell through to testing the Work cell. A future maintainer adding a State column would not get the protection the gate's name promises.
validator_p1_correction.fix: Use headers.indexOf('State') for state (returns -1 when no State column; falls back to checking Work, which is the actual semantic intent for current-frontier rows).
validator_p1_correction.proof_that_fix_works: Three runnable fixtures demonstrate RED/RED/GREEN. Before the fix, fixture A and B would have PASSed despite malformed state, because state was effectively always empty (aliased to work).
validator_p1_correction.latent_gate7_bug_also_fixed: Closing-braces were missing for the Deferred/hold loop on HEAD; the bug was invisible on the real board because findTableUnder('## Deferred / hold') returned the first table after that heading (Recently closed transitions, which has no State column), so the broken code path was never exercised. The fixtures exposed this latent bug; the correction is included in 7b0a57d22.

p2_opportunistic_tightening.what: ALL_INDEX_LINKS_RELATIVE now rejects root-absolute paths (/...) and file:// URLs in addition to http(s)://.
p2_opportunistic_tightening.rationale: Contract sec 7 requires 'relative repository links only'; the prior implementation was closer to NO_HTTP_URLS than to the full rule. GitHub recommends relative repository links for clone-utility; root-absolute paths break that.
p2_opportunistic_tightening.real_board_impact: None (no absolute or root-absolute links in the current board).

rationale: Per the factory reviewer (PASS_WITH_NONBLOCKING_RESIDUE, C1: GO): the previously identified P1 (validator aliased state and work to the same Work cell in Gate 6 / Gate 8 for Current frontier) is closed at commit 7b0a57d22, and the runnable negative-power fixtures prove the validator can FAIL on malformed inputs (not merely PASS the present board).
